item.name: MOB-009 Fetch products and choose an in-stock product

request.description: Fetch products and choose an in-stock product. Expected HTTP 200.

exec: const products = pm.response.json().products || []; const p = products.find(p => Number(p.stock) >= 3);
pm.test('An in-stock product fixture exists', () => pm.expect(p).to.be.an('object'));
